name: King County Conservation Futures (nonprofit open space acquisition)

funder.name: King County Department of Natural Resources and Parks

summary: Grants for open space acquisition by Washington-registered nonprofit nature conservancies in King County. First-time nonprofit applicants must first pass an eligibility and capacity review; the 2026 review intake has closed and the next opens in June 2027. Projects include natural areas and open space; some fund community gardens or farm access.

applicant_types.quote: Conservation Futures grants may be awarded to nonprofits that are registered with Washington State and meet the following definitions of either a nonprofit nature conservancy or nonprofit historic preservation corporation

access.quote: Conservation Futures grants for open space acquisition may be available to nature conservancy and historic preservation nonprofits.
